timing.summary: c1 concerns an empty-buffer encoding result introduced by g0001. c2 is a preexisting empty-fragment status coverage gap that remains after g0001.

coverage_evidence.dependency_reason: The complete fixed harness shows every target call.
The supplied build recipe includes the changed source and target harness.

claims.necessity_reason: Covering the new empty-buffer encoding result requires a target call with an explicit encoding; changing fuzz input bytes cannot supply that argument.

before.requirement: Reach an empty-buffer result whose encoding reflects an explicit encoding such as encoding_utf16_le.
before.reason: The old empty branch returned make_parse_result without assigning the resolved encoding. The result constructor initialized encoding to encoding_auto, so this result did not exist before g0001.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The old result constructor initializes encoding to encoding_auto.
The unchanged encoding resolver accepts an explicit encoding.

after.requirement: Reach the new empty-buffer result with encoding equal to an explicit choice such as encoding_utf16_le.
after.reason: The new empty branch assigns the resolved encoding, but every fixed harness call omits the encoding argument. Its default is encoding_auto, which resolves to encoding_utf8 for zero bytes.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The unchanged resolver sends encoding_auto to autodetection.
Autodetection returns encoding_utf8 for a zero-length buffer.
The unchanged API defaults the omitted encoding argument to encoding_auto.

claims.comparison_reason: The explicit-encoding result was absent before g0001. After g0001 it exists, and the fixed harness cannot reach it because it never passes an explicit encoding.

claims.necessity_reason: Covering the supported status_ok result for an empty fragment requires a call whose options include parse_fragment; changing fuzz input bytes cannot change the fixed options.

before.requirement: Reach status_ok when loading a zero-length buffer with parse_fragment.
before.reason: The old empty branch selected status_ok only when options included parse_fragment. The fixed harness used default, minimal, and full options, none of which includes that flag.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The unchanged header defines parse_minimal as zero.
The unchanged header defines parse_fragment separately from parse_default and parse_full.

after.requirement: Reach status_ok when loading a zero-length buffer with parse_fragment.
after.reason: The new empty branch retains the same parse_fragment status condition. The fixed harness still supplies no options containing parse_fragment.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The unchanged header defines parse_minimal as zero.
The unchanged header defines parse_fragment separately from parse_default and parse_full.

claims.comparison_reason: The same fixed options omit parse_fragment on both sides. The encoding assignment added by g0001 does not change this status condition.
